speaker: Howard
text: Just a few more feet and here we are, gentlemen. The gates of Elzebub. Stay frosty. There's a horde of armed goblins on the other side of that gate guarding the sword of Azarath.

speaker: Leonard
text: Good Lord. Don't panic, this is what the last 97 hours have been about. Warriors, unsheathe your weapons. Magic wielders, raise your wands. Lock and load.

speaker: Leonard
text: Blowing the gates. Control. Shift. D.

speaker: Howard
text: God, so many goblins! Don't just stand there, slash and move! Slash and move! Leonard, you got one on your tail!

speaker: Leonard
text: I've got my tail freehand style. I'll fight him off.

speaker: Howard
text: I got him, Leonard! Tonight I spice my meat with goblin blood! Last level to trap the fucking us!

speaker: Howard
text: Sheldon, he's got Raj! Use your sleep spell! Sheldon! Sheldon! I've got the sword of Azaroth!

speaker: Leonard
text: Get the sword! Sheldon, help Raj!

speaker: Howard
text: There is no more Sheldon! I am the sword master! Leonard, look out! Goodbye, peasants!

speaker: Leonard
text: Damn it, no one's dying here!

speaker: Leonard
text: Master teleported. He's selling the sword of Azaroth on eBay. You betrayed us for money? Who are you?

speaker: Howard
text: I'm a rogue night elf. Don't you people read character descriptions? Wait, wait, wait. Somebody just clicked buy it now.
